press_references.value: OPay Introduces Emergency Lock and Safety PIN to Help Nigerians Stay Protected

product_launches.description: OPay launched two new in-app security features, Emergency Lock and Safety PIN, giving Nigerian customers the ability to instantly freeze their accounts for 24 hours, including via a covert PIN entry during coercion, to prevent fraudulent or forced transactions.

press_references.value: OPay unveils product to reimburse unauthorised transactions

product_launches.description: OPay launched XtraCova, a funds-protection product that reimburses customers up to ₦5 million per validated claim for verified unauthorized transactions on their OPay accounts.

press_references.value: No more surprise charges, Instantly turn off recurring payments with your OPay card

product_launches.description: OPay has launched a new Card Control feature that allows users to instantly view, pause, or turn off recurring payments tied to their OPay card directly from the app, giving users greater control over subscription charges.

press_references.value: OPay’s NightGuard saved me from losing life savings – Customer

product_launches.description: NightGuard is a security feature that uses facial recognition to authorize payments during late-night hours, preventing unauthorized access.

press_references.value: OPay introduces "Large Transaction Shield" to guard against financial fraud

product_launches.description: OPay introduces a new security feature, Large Transaction Shield, combining biometric verification with transaction approval to enhance user security against financial fraud.

product_launches.description: OPay launched a multi-service super app combining payments, ride-hailing, and delivery.

overview_description.description: OPay designs a mobile payment service and consumer platform for users to send and receive money, pay bills, and order food and groceries. It empowers and enables users to accomplish more with their money by providing smart financial services. It is a one-stop mobile-based platform for payment, transportation, food and grocery delivery, and other important services in everyday life. Millions of users rely on OPay every day to send and receive money, pay bills, and order food and groceries.
